argv:
java -version
runtime_version="$(java -XshowSettings:properties -version 2>&1 | awk '$1 == "java.runtime.version" { print $3 }')"
if [ "$runtime_version" != '21.0.12.1+1-LTS' ]; then
  echo "JDK 运行版本与冻结基线不一致：$runtime_version" >&2
  exit 1
fi
